_README: Machine-enforceable form of the ROUTING DIRECTIVE in wiki/synthesis/thesis.md. Findings matching a rule are NOT deleted — they are moved to outOfStrategy[] in data/audit-findings.json with the directive line that classified them, so they stay auditable and reversible. Edit this file to change what the pipeline works on.
_WHY: On 2026-08-06 the audit filed findings recommending meta rewrites on pages the kill list has forbidden touching since 2026-07-24. Sending the full thesis in the prompt reduced but did not eliminate this — 3 violations survived with the complete directive in context. A rule that governs what the pipeline may act on has to be enforced in code, not requested in a prompt.
_HOW_TO_REVERSE: Delete a rule, or add the page to its `exceptPages`. Findings reappear on the next audit — nothing was destroyed.

alwaysInScope._why: Correctness and revenue-capture findings are never filtered, whatever the current growth strategy. A factual error on a spec page is wrong regardless of where traffic is coming from, and a missing affiliate link is money already on the table.

rules.directive: Absolutely stop: ... farming AI-Overview-eaten informational queries (knee-pain, correct-dimensions, spec pages); meta-tweaking suppressed pages
rules.why: These pages rank well for informational queries that AI Overviews answer in-place. The click is taken before the SERP is read, so a snippet rewrite cannot recover it. /knee-pain-seat-depth/ carries 41% of site impressions at 0.04% CTR and has already absorbed multiple meta rewrites without moving.
Below position 8 the snippet is rarely the binding constraint — rank is. Rewriting meta on a page at position 20 optimizes something nobody sees. Kill list, decisions-log 2026-08-04.

rules.directive: freeze new content ~30 days ... ship the monetization pivot before writing anything new
rules.why: Expanding a thin page is new content work in disguise. Flag it, do not schedule it, until the freeze lifts.
